extension.description: Reads ScenePass .sp.json sidecars next to video files and skips detected intro and recap segments during playback.
extension.news: v0.01.48 - Collaboration themes always require the matching skin to be installed and active. Removed the testing toggle. v0.01.47 - New: testing switch in Themes to enforce collaboration skin restrictions. Off allows Cinema and Madnox on any skin in previews and playback; turn it on again before release. This testing build defaults to off. v0.01.46 - New: four approved Madnox collaboration themes: original artwork, icon and glow, charcoal pill, and addon-coloured dimensional lettering. Full red/gold logos remain untinted. The original legacy Madnox Pill settings are preserved. v0.01.45 - Improved: preview captions move slightly right for left-corner buttons and left for right-corner buttons, giving the examples more space. v0.01.44 - Fixed: coloured glows retain their soft transparency instead of rendering as solid shapes. This applies to Accent underline and the new Accent + icon style. v0.01.43 - New: Cinema Pill style 5, Accent + icon, using the supplied 05-addon-accent-icon artwork. The chosen segment accent colours the icon, underline and glow; ivory lettering and charcoal background stay fixed. v0.01.42 - Removed: Cinema Pill style 5, Coloured icon + glow. Pill now has four styles; both Text styles are retained. Existing selections of the removed Pill style fall back to Original gold. v0.01.41 - Fixed: colour picker now occupies one full page, with clear Current/New values, spatial navigation, RGB/hex entry, Use colour and Cancel. The manager is hidden while editing so its Apply/Cancel cannot be confused with picker actions. - Fixed: the coloured under-button footprint now matches the supplied Cinema design, drawn behind the original panel rather than as a faint line overlay. v0.01.40 - Fixed: Cinema accent-coloured glows were barely visible in the supplied masks. An independent glow layer now makes Intro/Recap accent colours visible in Pill and Text previews and playback, preserving the original artwork and solid gold underline. v0.01.39 - Improved: Up on the top row wraps to the bottom row; Down on the bottom row wraps to the top, preserving horizontal alignment where possible. v0.01.38 - Fixed: all Theme Manager navigation follows visible control geometry. Arrows stay in the same row/column where possible, otherwise choose the nearest control in that direction. At an outside edge focus stays put. v0.01.37 - Fixed: theme-row Left/Right stays on Text, Pill and Cinema. Down from Text enters Pill (5) when Cinema is selected; Down from Pill enters the mockup top-left corner. v0.01.36 - Improved: Theme Manager groups themes into ScenePass and Collaborations. - Improved: collaboration focus explains the skin requirement. - Fixed: mockup arrows move between corners in their actual direction; outer edges return to the left pane or the theme section above. v0.01.35 - New: Theme Manager with staged live previews, relevant colour controls, named screen corners, Apply and Cancel. - New: Cinema with five Pill styles and two Text styles, for approved Aeon SceneCast skins. - Changed: Pill offers a clean capsule and the existing Madnox-logo design; collaboration themes will be added separately. - Fixed: collaboration themes recheck the installed active skin when rendering, and fall back to Text if unavailable. v0.01.34 - New: Settings > Appearance "Restore default position" puts the Skip button back at bottom right. - Changed: "Preview theme..." now shows Skip Intro in the left corners and Skip Recap in the right, each in its own colours, and the unselected corners are easier to see. It uses what you just changed without saving first, opens on your current position, and afterwards returns you to the Appearance tab with your choice shown. - Fixed: in the colour chooser and theme preview, the white focus ring could start on the wrong item. - New: Settings > ScenePass "Hide skip button automatically" (off by default, so the button stays for the whole intro or recap as before). Turn it on and an unpressed Skip button disappears after "Hide after (seconds)" (default 10) and the intro or recap plays on. - Changed: "Minimum segment length" now defaults to 8 seconds (was 5). If you never changed it, it now uses 8. v0.01.33 - New: Settings > Appearance "Button position" -- put the Skip button in any corner of the screen (1 bottom right, the original place; 2 bottom left; 3 top left; 4 top right). - Changed: "Preview theme..." is now one screen: a mini TV screen with the button in all four corners, in your theme (Text/Pill) and colours. Pick Text or Pill underneath, then click a corner to save both. - Changed: the colour chooser is redesigned: 36 named colours, Red/Green/Blue sliders (left/right to adjust, OK to type a value), a NOW | NEW comparison bar, Custom hex entry, and Default / Reset for that colour. The bottom row shows the colour name, its hex code and which setting it saves to. - Removed: the "Minimum confidence" setting. Every .sp sidecar is now used, whatever its confidence. - Changed: "Quality gates" heading renamed to "Quality gate". v0.01.32 - Fixed: the "Pill colour" and "Pill text colour" headings (added in v0.01.29) never appeared, and Kodi logged "unknown setting type lsep" each time the settings loaded. They now show, in Pill theme only, and appear or disappear straight away when Button theme is switched. - Changed: "Could not resolve playback path for sidecar lookup" is now only logged with Debug logging on. It appeared after almost every trailer closed (the player had already let go of the file) and wasn't an error. v0.01.31 - Fixed: the Family Share playback heartbeat no longer slows down the start of playback on network shares. It used to search every parent folder of each file the moment it opened, all the way up to the server itself, where Kodi tried to look up ".scenepass" as a server name (blocking lookups and "Unable to lookup host" errors in the log). It now stops at the share, remembers each folder's answer for 10 minutes, only checks real files (network shares and local paths, never pvr://, upnp:// and the like), and waits until a video has played for 10 seconds, so trailers and clips stopped early skip it entirely. v0.01.30 - New: Settings > ScenePass > Quality gates has "Let ScenePass scanners ease off the drive while playing" (on by default). While a video plays from a library set up with ScenePass Family Share, this addon writes a small heartbeat file into that library's shared folder so ScenePass on other PCs can drop to a single scanner reading that drive, keeping playback smooth. It only ever writes inside a library that already has Family Share configured -- nothing is written anywhere else -- and the heartbeat is removed the instant playback stops. v0.01.29 - Fixed: "Pill text colour" stayed visible as an empty heading in Text theme even though every setting under it was correctly hidden -- a plain settings-group heading doesn't hide itself just because its contents do. Replaced with an lsep (a real, individually hideable setting) carrying the same visibility rule as its siblings. - New: a "Pill colour" heading now appears above the Skip Intro/Recap button colour settings when Button theme is set to Pill (no heading there in Text theme, where a "pill" label wouldn't make sense). - New: a second "Restore default colours" button now also appears in the Pill text colour section (Pill theme only) -- same action as the one further up, so there's no need to scroll back to reset while working in this section. v0.01.28 - Changed: Settings > Appearance's "Pill text colour" section (Skip Intro/Recap pill text colour, and their "Choose colour..." buttons) is now only shown when Button theme is set to Pill -- it has no effect in Text theme, so it's hidden there rather than always shown. - Changed: "Preview themes..." now shows Skip Intro AND Skip Recap stacked in each theme panel (previously just Intro stood in for both), each independently coloured from its own accent/pill-text settings, and always re-reads the current settings fresh -- never a stale/cached example. v0.01.27 - Changed: the colour picker's palette grid now jumps focus straight to OK after picking a swatch, so confirming a preset is a single further press. - New: Settings > Appearance has a "Preview themes..." button showing an actual live render of Text vs Pill side by side (using your current colours, not a static mockup), with a caption under each; click either to select it. - New: in Pill theme, the icon/label text drawn on top of the pill now has its own independent colour (Settings > Appearance's new "Pill text colour" section), separate from the pill's own colour. Defaults to white (no added tint, i.e. the plain glyph). The pill background texture and the glyph texture are now two separately-tinted layers instead of one fused image. v0.01.26 - Fixed: the button briefly flashed the wrong art on appearing (most visible in Pill theme, where plain text showed for a frame before the pill caught up). The overlay's image control had a hardcoded real texture (the Text-theme intro glyph) baked into its XML as a placeholder, which painted for one frame before onInit() had a chance to set the actual theme/kind-correct texture. That placeholder is now fully transparent instead, same trick already used for the invisible hit-button beside it. v0.01.25 - New: button themes. Settings > Appearance now has a "Button theme" choice: Text (the current no-background style, still the default) or Pill, a translucent rounded-pill background behind the exact same icon/label glyph. The pill uses the same intro/recap colour settings as Text -- one colour tint produces both the dim pill fill and the bright glyph automatically, no separate pill colour setting needed. v0.01.24 - Changed: default button colours are now Amber (FFBF00) for Skip Intro and deep blue (002DB2) for Skip Recap, matching the values already in use, rather than the original Orange/light blue. - New: Settings > Colours has a "Restore default colours" button, resetting both to the above with a brief on-screen confirmation. v0.01.23 - Fixed: the colour picker had no visible indicator of which swatch/field was currently focused when navigating by keyboard/remote (every grid swatch shares one texture and tint for both its focused and unfocused state, so they looked pixel-identical). Added a two-tone (black+white) focus-ring overlay that follows the current focus onto whichever control it lands on, visible against any swatch colour including pure black or white. v0.01.22 - Fixed: the colour picker dialog only responded to mouse clicks, not keyboard/remote d-pad navigation. None of its controls declared onup/ondown/onleft/onright, and Kodi's automatic geometry-based navigation fallback doesn't reliably link a mixed grid-of-buttons-plus-edit-fields layout like this one. Every one of the 54 focusable controls (the 48-swatch grid, the 4 hex/R/G/B fields, OK, Cancel) now has an explicit navigation graph wired up. v0.01.21 - Fixed: "Choose colour..." crashed with RuntimeError "No valid addon id could be obtained" -- xbmcaddon.Addon() was called with no argument, which only resolves automatically when a script is launched through a declared extension point; the colour picker is launched via RunScript() against a raw file path instead, so that inference has nothing to go on. Now passes the addon id explicitly everywhere xbmcaddon.Addon() is called. v0.01.20 - New: Settings > Colours now has a "Choose colour..." button per segment kind, opening a custom hex/RGB picker dialog: a 48-swatch colour grid (8-hue x 6-row HSV spectrum) to click/navigate through, plus a live preview swatch and separate hex/R/G/B fields for exact values. Built from scratch rather than Kodi's native colour picker, which only exists on Kodi 20 (Nexus) and newer -- this works on Nexus and older too, and stays fully usable from a remote/d-pad (no drag-to-sample gradient that needs a pointer). v0.01.19 - New: Skip Intro / Skip Recap button colour is now configurable (Settings > Colours), either by typing a hex value directly or via the new colour-picker button. Defaults unchanged (Orange for intro, Blue for recap). The baked button art is now a neutral white/alpha shape tinted at render time, rather than pre-colored, so any chosen colour renders accurately. v0.01.18 - Fixed: the invisible hit-button behind the overlay art was showing the active Kodi skin's own default focused-button box (a colored pill), because it lost its explicit texture override when the old composed-pill assets were removed. Restored an explicit (fully transparent) texture reference. v0.01.17 - Fixed: repo listing showed a generic/black thumbnail. addon.xml never declared an <assets> block, so the repo generator wasn't copying icon.png/fanart.jpg alongside the packaged zip where Kodi actually fetches them from (repo uses datadir zip="true"). v0.01.16 - Switched intro/recap text art from the neon-glow look to a flat solid-color style (still no pill background) v0.01.15 - Skip Intro switched from the dark-pill design to the unified glow-text-only style (matching Skip Recap): orange for intro, blue for recap, no pill background on either v0.01.14 - Fixed: skip overlay could render invisible (or briefly flash then vanish) on some systems. Root cause: a <visible> condition on a control in a dialog stacked over fullscreen video — whether a literal true/false or a Window.Property() condition — never evaluates true here, so the control never paints no matter what Python sets. Visibility is now handled purely by Control.setVisible(), the one mechanism confirmed to work; no control in the skin uses a <visible> tag anymore. v0.01.6 - Skip Intro now renders from a designed baked-art asset (dark pill, hollow-outline text/icon) - Skip Recap test variant: glowing text/icon only, no pill background, for side-by-side evaluation against Skip Intro v0.01.5 - Skip overlay: colored pill (orange for intro, blue for recap) with a circular play badge overlapping the right edge, ring baked into the badge texture v0.01.4 - Closer label-to-arrow spacing (~2-character gap; narrower pill) v0.01.3 - Tighter skip button width (~3-letter gap before arrow); lighter grey background v0.01.2 - Skip overlay: grey pill background, PNG play arrow (fixes skin font/icon glitches) v0.01.1 - Netflix-style Skip Intro / Skip Recap overlay buttons (replaces blocking dialog) v0.01.0 - ScenePass .sp.json consumer - Auto-skip or on-screen prompt for intro and recap - Confidence and minimum-duration gates
